display.title: Episode 134: The Stone for the Beis HaMikdash (Shabbos Mevarchim Av)
display.summary_short: Poor Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa finds a perfect stone for the Beis HaMikdash, and angels carry it once he lifts a finger. Also: Rosh Chodesh Av and Ahavas Yisroel.
display.summary_long: A summer program during the Three Weeks. Uncle Yossi thanks listeners for their letters, even the scribbles of little ones who cannot write yet. Story time tells of Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, too poor to bring a gift for building the Beis HaMikdash. Praying by the roadside, he realizes the stone he is sitting on is a perfect cube, fit for a cornerstone, but he cannot budge it. After a young guest leads the Shema, five strangers, really angels, offer to carry it, but the stone only floats toward Yerushalayim once Rabbi Chanina puts his little finger under it. The lessons: every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash, and 'you try your best, and Hashem will do the rest'. Uncle Yossi then explains that Rosh Chodesh, Av this coming Monday, is the 'head' of the month, from which the whole month draws its blessings, and describes the prayer of Shabbos Mevarchim. A letter from two girls includes a drawing of Har Sinai. The show ends with a call for Ahavas Yisroel: Hashem, like a parent, delights most when His children love one another.
display.lesson: Try your best and Hashem will do the rest; every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash, and loving one another undoes the baseless hatred that destroyed it.

date.note: 'This coming Monday... Rosh Chodesh Av' and 'this coming Shabbos Mevarchim': 1 Av 5744 was Monday 30 July 1984. Most of the show repeats episode 33 (5742).

privacy.note: Shema guest and two letter writers named in full.

sources_cited.note: The story is introduced as 'told by our Chachamim'.
The Shabbos Mevarchim prayer for a month of life, peace, joy and redemption.
